title: Text alternatives
instruction: Give informative images a text alternative. Mark decorative images so assistive technology can ignore them.
rationale: WCAG 2.2 success criterion 1.1.1, level A, with the decorative, control, and sensory exceptions in the quick reference.
verificationMethod: DOM scan for missing alt, plus manual review of whether the text is equivalent.
exceptions: Decorative images with an empty alt
CAPTCHA and sensory exceptions require a described purpose

title: Contrast minimum
instruction: Body text needs at least 4.5:1. Large text needs at least 3:1. Do not collapse every contrast rule into one number.
verificationMethod: Computed contrast for explicit color pairs.

title: Keyboard operation
instruction: The primary contact path must be operable by keyboard and must not trap focus.
verificationMethod: Detect scripts that cancel Tab without an exit. Full keyboard testing remains manual where the verifier does not run a browser.
exceptions: A modal may hold Tab while it is open if Escape or an explicit close control releases it

title: Focus not obscured
instruction: Sticky or fixed interface must not cover the focused control. Reserve scroll padding for the sticky region.
verificationMethod: Static check for sticky or fixed positioning without scroll-padding-top.

title: Form labels
instruction: Name every contact field in a way that states its purpose. Placeholder text is not the name.
verificationMethod: Accessible name from label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.
exceptions: Submit buttons with their own text

title: Error identification
instruction: When a required contact field can fail, identify the error in text associated with the field.
rationale: WCAG 2.2 success criterion 3.3.1, level A, together with status feedback in 4.1.3.
verificationMethod: Required controls must point at an existing described-by or error element.

title: Screen reader evaluation
instruction: Record that screen-reader behavior was not claimed from an accessibility-tree snapshot.
rationale: W3C evaluation guidance says tools cannot by themselves determine conformance.
verificationMethod: Manual. Pending manual coverage is disclosed and is not itself a universal launch deadlock.

title: Carousel keyboard behavior
instruction: When a carousel is used, previous and next controls need names and keyboard operation. Do not autoplay.
rationale: APG widget practice. Irrelevant when the page has no carousel.
verificationMethod: Load only when the carousel island is present. Kernel carousel uses buttons and arrow keys and does not autoplay.

title: Plain language and error recovery
instruction: Use the visitor's words for the next step. If a form fails, say what went wrong and how to fix it.
rationale: Nielsen heuristics 2 and 9. They are not a blocking standard by themselves.
verificationMethod: Advisory. A semantic concern becomes a failure only after a verifier or a human review confirms it.

title: Indexing intent
instruction: Preview may be noindex. Production noindex on a page meant to be found is a launch blocker.
rationale: Google documents opting out of indexing. Vitris treats an accidental production noindex as a technical SEO defect.
verificationMethod: Compare robots meta with environment and the page's indexing intent.

title: Canonical origin
instruction: Production canonical URLs use the configured public origin and a route that exists.
rationale: Google's starter guide treats a preferred URL as the way to handle duplicates. A wrong host is a technical defect.
verificationMethod: Compare canonical href with publicOrigin and built routes.
exceptions: Missing publicOrigin is a preview warning and a production blocker

title: Sitemap exclusions
instruction: Production sitemaps use absolute URLs and omit redirects, retired URLs, and intentionally nonindexable pages.
rationale: A sitemap should list URLs you want crawled. It is not proof that every historical URL was discovered.
verificationMethod: Compare sitemap loc values with route dispositions.

title: Redirect integrity
instruction: Every discovered material URL needs keep, redirect, consolidate, or retire. Reject loops, missing destinations, and accidental homepage redirects.
rationale: URL changes need an explicit destination. Harvest coverage is not a claim that every old URL was found.
verificationMethod: Graph walk of storyboard route dispositions.

title: Structured data consistency
instruction: Use Organization unless a real address supports LocalBusiness. The entity must match visible content. Do not invent ratings or service areas.
rationale: Structured data validity, visible consistency, and rich-result eligibility are different checks.
verificationMethod: Parse JSON-LD and compare name, type, and address with visible facts.
exceptions: Eligibility for a rich result is not claimed

title: Answer the visitor in visible text
instruction: Answer the questions a visitor actually has, in the page, with the business and services identified from evidence. Do not add FAQ blocks, fake credentials, or city pages to chase citations.
rationale: Google says its AI features rely on existing SEO foundations and do not need special files. Other providers are not covered.
exceptions: Experimental crawler files require a separate reviewed policy

title: Starting transfer budget
instruction: Keep first-party JavaScript and CSS within the versioned Vitris budgets. A broken or empty shipped resource blocks. Lab timing stays a warning while variance is calibrated.
rationale: These limits are Vitris policy. Core Web Vitals remain field targets and are unknown until measured.
verificationMethod: Gzip and byte totals. Unavailable lab or field data stays unknown.

title: Field Core Web Vitals
instruction: Do not mark LCP, INP, or CLS passed from a missing field sample or a single lab run.
rationale: web.dev defines the 75th percentile field targets. Lab measurement is prelaunch evidence only.
verificationMethod: Record unknown when field data or the lab runner is absent.

title: Bound launch evidence
instruction: Production publication requires evidence tied to the same build and policy. A passed flag in an unbound JSON file is not evidence.
rationale: Supported CLI, site script, CI, and Worker paths share this rule. Manual uploads outside those paths are not prevented.
verificationMethod: Shared launch decision. Worker pages upload fails closed without a trusted receipt for the same build hash.
exceptions: An explicit scoped override is reported as waived, not passed

title: Creative freedom
instruction: Accept restrained pages, purposeful repetition, and alternate accessible compositions. Flag novelty only when it creates a visitor or implementation defect.
rationale: Teaching guidance. It does not outrank a confirmed accessibility, functionality, or indexing failure.
verificationMethod: Critic must name a visitor problem, business mismatch, or defect.
